day_shape: 84 items: Trump claims Iran downed a US Apache over the Strait of Hormuz and "must" be answered, IDF orders Tyre evacuation and strikes southern Lebanon, a Lebanon-border gunman is killed after firing on troops, satellite imagery shows possible damage at Ramat David, and Khamenei/Qalibaf cycle heavy 100-days-of-jihad messaging.

threads.label: Apache downing claim over Hormuz
threads.summary: Trump said on Truth Social that Iranian forces shot down a US Apache helicopter patrolling the Strait of Hormuz overnight, that both pilots were safe, and that the US "must respond." Times of Israel reported the aircraft as crashed near the Strait; IRIB amplified Trump's wording as a claim.

threads.label: Lebanon border: Tyre strikes and infiltrator
threads.summary: The IDF issued a second evacuation order for Tyre including its Christian quarter and struck the city, while a gunman who crossed from Lebanon and fired on troops near Ramim Ridge was shot dead with no Israeli injuries. Defa Press reported Israeli airstrikes on Kafra, Sajad, Jubshait and the Al-Bass camp; the IDF said Givati troops north of the Litani located Hezbollah weapons depots in Zawtar al-Gharbiyah and al-Sharqiyah.

threads.label: Iran strikes on Israel and IDF posture
threads.summary: Satellite imagery published by Jerusalem Post and Times of Israel suggested damage near a hangar at Ramat David air base from Iranian missile strikes, while IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir said Israel was postured to strike Iran again and had planned a "more significant and severe blow." The IDF also said it downed a Houthi drone over Eilat.

threads.label: US-Iran deal signalling
threads.summary: Trump said the US would declare "total victory" over Iran within two weeks and a deal in "2-3 days", while Vice President Vance told media the US would pursue an agreement "even if Israel opposes" and called it a "home run." IRIB cited CNN counting at least 37 Trump promises that a deal was close since the war began, and Iran's deputy foreign minister Ghoribzadeh called the US/E3 IAEA Board of Governors resolution draft a "dangerous attempt" to absolve aggressors.

threads.label: Regime 100-days-of-jihad messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted that Iran was "not a seeker of war" but would not relinquish its rights, and warned of "miscalculation" by officials in a message marking Imam Khomeini's death anniversary. Speaker Qalibaf marked 100 days of "the Iranian nation's jihad" and said Iran preferred diplomacy but spoke "other languages far more fluently"; IRIB reported a Tehran municipality employee "martyred" on the hundredth day.

threads.label: Gaza strikes and Cairo factions talks
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck the main headquarters of Hamas's Naval Police in Khan Younis, killing cell commander Ismail al-Lahham, and killed two Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives, including Nukhba commander Iyad Nofal, in southern Gaza. Jerusalem Post reported Fatah boycotted Cairo factions talks over Hamas's refusal to disarm, while Islamic Jihad said Israeli assassinations during the talks aimed to undermine a Gaza ceasefire.

threads.label: Iranian home front and humanitarian toll
threads.summary: UN OCHA's Situation Report 11 said destruction of more than 149,000 civilian infrastructures inside Iran had directly impacted over 400,000 people as of 29 April. Iran International reported eco-tourism operators warning of closures and teenagers describing simple purchases as out of reach, while Iran accused the US of revoking World Cup ticket allocations for its supporters.

events.title: The gunman shot dead by IDF troops on the Lebanon border did not cross Israel's border fence, which is built several meters inside Israeli territory, according to a preliminary investigation carried out by the army. According to the probe, IDF troops operating inside southern Lebanon came under fire from the gunman close to the border barrier, and returned fire. The gunman's body was located a short while later in an Israeli military zone on the western side of the border barrier. Meaning, the gunman technically crossed into Israeli territory, but did not infiltrate Israel's border fence.
